purpose: Provides Anthropic's official brand colors and typography so Claude can apply the Anthropic look-and-feel to artifacts (slides, documents, visuals) whenever brand or style guidelines or company design standards apply.
invariants: Specifies the exact Anthropic palette hex values: main colors (Dark, Light, Mid Gray, Light Gray) and accent colors (Orange, Blue, Green).
Specifies typography: Poppins for headings with an Arial fallback, and Lora for body text with a Georgia fallback.
Headings at 24pt and larger use Poppins; body text uses Lora.
Non-text shapes use the accent colors, cycling through orange, blue and green.
Text color is chosen based on the background, using the Dark and Light colors for contrast.
Fonts fall back to Arial or Georgia automatically when Poppins or Lora is unavailable, and no font installation is required.
Colors are applied as exact RGB values, for example through python-pptx's RGBColor.

Frontmatter keeps the name `brand-guidelines` and a description that says when to trigger the skill, which is when brand colors, style guidelines, visual formatting, or company design standards apply.
protected: - Dark: `#141413` - Primary text and dark backgrounds
- Light: `#faf9f5` - Light backgrounds and text on dark
